Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T18:33Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card, objectui#10682, and objectui `origin/main`.

Same family, same fix shape: a load error that the success path never clears (the objectui#10578 shape). The current gate folds same-family findings into one closure card (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20110). objectui#10682 is that card for the form side of the family, and it now carries this row (`LineItemsPanel`, rows drawn under a stale banner) with its probe and its region order after PR objectui#10650, at `priority:p2`. Neither card was claimed when the fold was made.
